title: User Registration Success
description: Verify that a new user can register successfully with valid inputs.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Enter valid username, email, and password fields.
Submit the registration form.
Confirm successful registration confirmation message is displayed.
Verify user is redirected to the login page or logged in automatically.

title: User Registration Validation Errors
description: Verify the registration form enforces data validation on invalid inputs.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Enter invalid email format, weak password, and missing required fields.
Submit the registration form.
Verify appropriate validation error messages are displayed for each invalid field.

title: User Login Success
description: Verify that users can login successfully using correct credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input valid username/email and password.
Click login button.
Verify user is authenticated and redirected to the homepage or user dashboard.

title: User Login Failure
description: Verify that login fails with incorrect credentials and proper error messages are shown.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input incorrect or non-existent username/email and/or password.
Click login button.
Verify error message indicating invalid login credentials is displayed.

title: Product Browsing and Listing Display
description: Verify products are listed correctly with all required information visible.

steps.description: Navigate to the product listing page.
Verify list of products is displayed with images, names, prices, and brief descriptions.
Check that products are loaded without errors and page loads in timely manner.

title: Product Search Functionality
description: Verify the product search feature returns relevant results based on search criteria.

steps.description: Enter keywords or filters in the search bar on the products page.
Submit the search.
Verify the product listing is updated with products matching the search criteria.
Search with no matching results shows appropriate user feedback.

title: Product Customization Validations
description: Verify users can customize a product and options selected are applied properly.

steps.description: Navigate to a product customization page.
Select all available customization options (color, size, engraving, etc.).
Submit the customized product.
Verify selected customizations are reflected in the product preview and summary.

title: Add Product to Shopping Cart
description: Verify a user can add a product to the shopping cart from the product or customization page.

steps.description: Browse to a product page.
Optionally perform product customization.
Click 'Add to Cart' button.
Verify the product is added to the shopping cart successfully with correct details.

title: Update Shopping Cart Item Quantity
description: Verify users can update the quantity of items in the shopping cart and totals are recalculated.

steps.description: Add product(s) to the shopping cart.
Navigate to the shopping cart page.
Change the quantity value of a product.
Verify shopping cart updates the quantity and recalculates the subtotals and total.

title: Remove Item from Shopping Cart
description: Verify a user can remove items from the shopping cart and cart updates accordingly.

steps.description: Add items to the shopping cart.
Navigate to the shopping cart page.
Click remove/delete button for one or more items.
Verify removed items no longer appear and cart totals are updated.

title: Checkout Process - Successful Order Placement
description: Verify that user can complete a checkout process and receive order confirmation.

steps.description: Add items to shopping cart.
Proceed to checkout page.
Enter valid shipping address and payment information.
Submit the order.
Verify order is processed successfully and confirmation details are displayed.

title: Checkout Process - Payment Failure Handling
description: Verify the checkout flow handling when payment is declined or invalid.

steps.description: Add items to shopping cart.
Proceed to checkout page.
Enter invalid or declined payment details.
Submit the order.
Verify proper error message is displayed indicating payment failure.
Verify user remains on checkout page for correction without order creation.

title: User Profile Update Success
description: Verify that a user can update personal profile details successfully.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the user profile page.
Modify user details such as name, email (if allowed), and address.
Submit the updated profile information.
Verify confirmation message that profile is updated successfully.
Verify updated values are correctly saved and shown on profile page.

title: User Password Change
description: Verify user can change password and login with the new password afterwards.

steps.description: Navigate to profile password change section.
Enter current password and new password details.
Submit password change.
Verify password change confirmation message is displayed.
Logout and attempt login with new password.
Verify login is successful using the new password.

title: Order History Listing
description: Verify that the user can view a list of past orders correctly.

steps.description: Login and navigate to order history page.
Verify orders are listed with order ID, date, status, and total amount.
Verify empty order history shows appropriate messaging.

title: Order Detail View
description: Verify that users can view detailed information for a selected order.

steps.description: Navigate to order history and select an order.
Verify order details page shows items purchased, quantities, prices, shipping info, and status.

title: News Articles Display
description: Verify news articles are displayed correctly with title, date, and content previews.

steps.description: Navigate to the news section.
Verify list of news articles is shown with correct titles and published dates.
Select a news article.
Verify full content of the news article is displayed without errors.

title: Product Reviews Listing and Details
description: Verify that product reviews are displayed and details are accessible.

steps.description: Navigate to the reviews page or section for a product.
Verify list of reviews is displayed with reviewer name, rating, and summary.
Select a review for detailed content.
Verify full review text and associated product information appears.
